parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall metal shelving units filled with cardboard boxes. In the foreground, a large metal cage-like container wrapped in plastic sits on a pallet. A forklift is partially visible to the right. The floor is concrete, and lighting fixtures hang from the ceiling.

objects.label: metal cage container
objects.observation: Large rectangular metal cage with grid pattern, wrapped in clear plastic, resting on a wooden pallet. Positioned centrally in the foreground. Partially obscures background shelves. Appears freestanding on concrete floor.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple stacked cardboard boxes on high shelves in the background. Some have green labels. Boxes are arranged neatly on orange-painted metal racks extending into the distance. Not directly contacting foreground objects.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall industrial shelving made of steel beams and orange-painted horizontal bars. Supports multiple levels of stored boxes. Located behind the cage container. Visible structural supports extend upward out of frame.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift partially visible on the right side of the image, near the back of the shelving unit. Its forks are down, and it appears stationary. Only rear section and part of the cab are visible.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth gray concrete surface covering the entire ground area. Serves as base for all objects. Shows some minor scuff marks and shadows from surrounding structures.
